phel.lsp.enabled.markdownDescription: Opt-in (default off): use the Phel language server (`phel lsp`) for completion, hover, signature help, go-to-definition, find references, rename, symbols, formatting, and diagnostics, backed by the Phel compiler with PHP-interop awareness (`php/->`, `php/::`, `php/new`). Best-effort today: some Phel releases ship a `phel lsp` that exits on idle, in which case the extension restarts it a few times and then falls back to its bundled providers. Enable once your Phel provides a stable server. Requires a reload to take effect.

phel.lsp.command.markdownDescription: Override `#phel.executablePath#` for the language server only. Empty string falls back to `#phel.executablePath#`. Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder. Changing this restarts a running server automatically. In a multi-root workspace only the first folder's value is used: the server is started once per window, rooted there.

phel.lsp.args.description: Arguments passed to the Phel CLI when starting the language server. Changing this restarts a running server automatically. In a multi-root workspace only the first folder's value is used: the server is started once per window, rooted there.

phel.cacheDirectory.description: Extra directory to search for compiled Phel files. The workspace's own `.phel/cache/compiled` (Phel's default, honouring PHEL_CACHE_DIR) and the system temp directory are always searched, so this is only needed for a custom cache location.

phel.debug.enabled.description: Enable Phel debug adapter for source-level debugging

phel.executablePath.markdownDescription: Path to the Phel CLI. Used by the language server, diagnostics, format, test, and REPL unless a per-command setting (`#phel.lsp.command#`, `#phel.diagnostics.command#`, `#phel.format.command#`, `#phel.test.command#`, `#phel.repl.command#`) overrides it. Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder; absolute paths are used as-is. Can be set per folder: in a multi-root workspace each project may point at its own binary.

phel.diagnostics.enabled.description: Run the diagnostics engine on open/save and surface the result as inline diagnostics.

enumDescriptions: Use `phel lint` when the CLI provides it, otherwise fall back to `phel analyze`.
Always use `phel lint --format=json`. Reports rule-based findings (unused bindings, arity, anything configured in `phel-lint.phel`) on top of what `analyze` reports.
Always use `phel analyze`. Semantic errors for the single file only.
phel.diagnostics.engine.description: Which Phel CLI subcommand backs inline diagnostics.

phel.diagnostics.live.markdownDescription: Also report analyzer diagnostics **as you type**, through a long-lived `phel api-daemon` (one per workspace folder, started on first use). Needs a Phel that has the `api-daemon` command; with an older one this silently does nothing. Findings the on-save engine already reports are not repeated. When `#phel.diagnostics.engine#` resolves to `analyze`, the same daemon serves the on-save run instead of spawning a CLI.

phel.diagnostics.command.markdownDescription: Override `#phel.executablePath#` for diagnostics only. Empty string falls back to `#phel.executablePath#`. Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder.

phel.completion.phpInterop.markdownDescription: Complete PHP symbols in interop positions — the members of the class behind `(php/-> receiver …)` / `(php/:: Class …)` / `(.method x)`, the classes behind `\Foo` and `(php/new \Foo)`, PHP's global functions after `php/`, and the superglobals after `php/$` — through the same long-lived `phel api-daemon` live diagnostics use, which reflects over the classes your project can actually load. Needs `#phel.diagnostics.live#` on and a Phel that has the `api-daemon` command; the daemon gets 400 ms per keystroke, so a busy or still-booting one costs nothing but the suggestion.

phel.format.enabled.description: Use `phel format` as the document formatter for .phel files.

phel.format.command.markdownDescription: Override `#phel.executablePath#` for formatting only. Empty string falls back to `#phel.executablePath#`. Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder.

phel.format.onType.markdownDescription: Indent the line as you type it - on Enter, and on a closing bracket typed at the start of a line - following the same rules `phel format` uses, so a save never has to move it again. Needs `#editor.formatOnType#`, which this extension turns on for `.phel` files.

phel.references.codeLens.description: Show a reference count above every definition, which opens the reference list when clicked.

phel.tests.codeLensEnabled.description: Show inline CodeLens shortcuts for running individual `deftest` forms and all tests in the current file.

phel.tests.preferNrepl.markdownDescription: Run Test Explorer tests over a live nREPL connection when there is one, instead of spawning `phel test`. The run reloads changed namespaces first, then asks the session for one test at a time — milliseconds each, with no PHP to boot. Never starts a server: without a connection (see **Phel: Connect to nREPL Server**) the subprocess runner is used unchanged, and a coverage run always uses it.

phel.tests.runOnSave.markdownDescription: Opt-in (default off): while an nREPL connection is live, saving a `.phel` file reloads and re-runs the tests it affects — its own `deftest`s, else the test file its namespace maps to, else every test file that `(:require`s it. Results land in the Testing view. Does not start a connection on its own.

phel.test.command.markdownDescription: Override `#phel.executablePath#` for the test CodeLens / Test Explorer. Empty string falls back to `#phel.executablePath#`. Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder.

phel.paredit.enabled.description: Register paredit-style structural editing commands (slurp / barf / raise / wrap).

phel.repl.enabled.description: Register Phel REPL commands (start, eval form / selection / next form / file).

phel.repl.command.markdownDescription: Override `#phel.executablePath#` for the REPL terminal. Empty string falls back to `#phel.executablePath#`. Relative paths resolve against the workspace folder.

phel.repl.args.description: Arguments passed to the Phel CLI when starting the REPL.

phel.repl.history.enabled.description: Append every form sent to the REPL to `.vscode/phel-repl-history.phel` in the workspace folder the form came from.

phel.nrepl.enabled.markdownDescription: Register Phel nREPL commands (connect, structured eval, reload, run tests in namespace / under cursor). The extension starts `phel nrepl` on a random free port and connects over the bencode-over-TCP protocol, giving structured eval results and live-runtime test runs.

phel.nrepl.reloadOnSave.markdownDescription: When an nREPL connection is active, reload changed namespaces automatically every time a `.phel` file is saved. Does not start a connection on its own.

phel.nrepl.hoverEval.markdownDescription: While an nREPL connection is active, hovering a symbol also shows what it currently evaluates to in the running program. Only symbols are evaluated (never the form around them), locals and literals are skipped, and an evaluation slower than 2 s is abandoned. Does not start a connection on its own.

phel.inlayHints.parameterNames.markdownDescription: Opt-in (default off): show the parameter name before each argument at a call site, `(assoc ds: m key: :k value: v)`. Only functions are labelled — a macro or special form does not bind its arguments positionally — and a label is dropped where it would add nothing or mislead: quoted data, a head shadowed by a local binding, an argument already spelled like the parameter, anything past a `& rest`, and every step of a `->>` / `some->>` / `cond->>` form, where the threaded value lands last.

phel.formHighlight.enabled.description: Highlight the form enclosing the cursor with a subtle background tint.

phel.migration.enabled.description: Flag what Phel 0.50 removed (the core aliases push, put, values, …; the reader syntax #| |#, bare # comments, |() short fns, foo$ gensyms, `,` unquote, ^:reference) and deprecated (php/new, php/->, php/::, set-var, the \ namespace separator), plus calls to your own :deprecated definitions, and offer a quick fix where the rewrite is mechanical. Turn off when targeting a Phel older than 0.50.

phel.ns.autoInsert.description: Give a newly created, still empty .phel file its (ns …) form, with the namespace read off how the neighbouring files map their own paths.

walkthroughs.title: Get started with Phel
walkthroughs.description: Install the Phel CLI, point the extension at it, then run tests, a REPL, and a debug session from the editor.

steps.title: Install Phel
steps.description:
Everything past highlighting shells out to the Phel CLI. In an existing project run `composer require phel-lang/phel`; Composer puts the binary at `vendor/bin/phel`.
[Read the getting started guide](https://phel-lang.org/documentation/getting-started/)

steps.title: Point at your CLI
steps.description:
`phel.executablePath` defaults to `vendor/bin/phel` and backs every subsystem. Change it only when your binary lives somewhere else.
[Open the setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%5B%22phel.executablePath%22%5D)

steps.title: Or scaffold a project
steps.description:
No project yet? **Phel: Init Project** picks a template, asks for a name, and runs `phel init` for you — composer.json, phel-config.php, and a src/ tree included.
[Init a project](command:phel.init)

steps.title: Check your setup
steps.description:
**Phel: Doctor** runs `phel doctor` into an output channel and tells you whether the CLI, `phel-config.php`, and the cache directory agree.
[Run Doctor](command:phel.doctor)

steps.title: Run the tests
steps.description:
Every `deftest` shows up in the Testing view and behind a `▶ Run test` CodeLens. **Phel: Watch Tests** keeps `phel test --watch` running in a terminal.
[Open the Testing view](command:workbench.view.testing.focus)
[Watch tests](command:phel.test.watch)

steps.title: Start a REPL
steps.description:
**Phel: Start REPL** opens a terminal you can send forms to with Ctrl/Cmd+Enter. The extension switches namespace for you when you eval from a different file.
[Start a REPL](command:phel.repl.start)

steps.title: Debug with breakpoints in .phel
steps.description:
With Xdebug enabled and a `type: "phel"` launch configuration, breakpoints, stack traces, and stepping all stay in your Phel source.
[Read the debugging guide](https://github.com/phel-lang/phel-vs-code-extension/blob/main/docs/debugging.md)

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint && npm run format:check
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile && npm run bundle && node ./out/test/integration/runTests.js
